desc: Derive and prove the level-by-level halving algorithm (F0/F1/Cross1 recurrences with c∈{0,1} offsets; Cross0 shown to be unreachable)
Handle odd+odd pairs via transform p=(o-1)/2 giving F1 with +1 offset; mixed even-odd pairs in F1/Cross1 recurse halved with c=1
Verify recurrence on sample 1 ([4,8]→5) and sample 2 ([51,44,63]→384) by hand

Design complexity/memory safeguards: F0 tail-loop over evens (telescoping odd-set sizes ≤ N), Cross1 recurses on smaller child and loops on larger (O(N) memory, O(N log Amax) time), singleton short-circuits

Write final Python solution with fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer), verified against samples 1 and 2 by hand-trace; code implements F0 (iterative halving loop), F1, and Cross1 (tail-loop on larger child) exactly as derived
